question: What is the pooled recorded-result win percentage in this reference scenario?
population: Synthetic reference cohorts: 1 win/1 result and 9 wins/99 results
period: Reference fixture only; not a current-meta analysis
grain: Player-result observations pooled across two cohorts
limitations: Illustrative arithmetic; no inference about current performance

q1.sql: select sum(wins) as numerator, sum(results) as denominator from (values (1,1),(9,99)) t(wins,results)
q1.database_revision: Self-contained VALUES fixture; no external database

claims.text: The pooled recorded-result win percentage is 10% in this fixture.
caveats: This is not a forecast or a current-meta recommendation.

rate.tie_policy: Ties remain in the recorded-result denominator
